finding: The overall mean relational coordination score across the 18 MCDPH services was 3.15 on a 1-5 scale.
quote: The overall average relational coordination score for MCDPH services was 3.15, which roughly equates to the middle survey option (occasionally, somewhat, or some).

finding: Service-level relational coordination scores varied significantly by the focus of the service (ANOVA, p < .001).
quote: Scores varied significantly according to the focus of the service (p < .001 per analysis of variance).

finding: Services providing internal capacity to the department had significantly higher mean relational coordination than other types (3.79, p < .01).
quote: Services providing internal capacity to MCDPH and other public health services (e.g., performance improvement) had significantly higher average relational coordination scores than other types (3.79, p < .01).

finding: Services delivering curative services to individuals had significantly lower relational coordination (2.64, p < .01).
quote: Services aimed at delivering curative services to individuals (e.g., health care for the homeless, clinical services) had statistically significantly lower levels of relational coordination (2.64, p < .01).

finding: Population health services (3.17) and preventive services to individual clients (3.06) did not differ significantly from other groups.
quote: Population health services and those delivering preventive services to individual clients (average relational coordination scores of 3.17 and 3.06, respectively) did not have significantly different relational coordination scores than other groups.

finding: Mutual respect (3.35), problem-solving (3.31), accurate (3.30) and timely communication (3.30) were the highest-scoring domains.
quote: Scores for mutual respect, problem-solving communication, accurate communication, and timely communication tended to be highest (3.30-3.35 on a scale from 1 to 5)

finding: Shared knowledge (2.88) and frequency of communication (2.84) were the lowest-scoring domains.
quote: whereas scores for shared knowledge and frequency of communication tended to be lowest (2.88 and 2.84, respectively).

finding: Shared goals scored 3.12, below the four highest domains.
quote: Shared goals 3.12 (0.12) .77

finding: Service-level relational coordination scores ranged from about 3.7 to 1.1.
quote: Overall relational coordination scores for public health services at MCDPH ranged from approximately 3.7 to 1.1.

finding: Purposive cross-program 'cloud' meetings were described as a facilitator: people met across office lines and became comfortable outside their silos; meetings gave an opportunity for problem-solving communication, shared knowledge and mutual respect.
quote: With the clouds, people just started meeting across office lines, so that to me was the impetus because people started getting comfortable outside of their silos.

finding: Organizational structure facilitated collaboration: the 2016 reorganization placing similar services closer, colocation/physical proximity, and alignment of target populations.
quote: a 2016 reorganization placed services with similar focus areas administratively closer to one another

finding: Organizational culture placed a priority on collaboration, seen by some as purposefully fostered by department leaders; knowledge of what others are working on facilitated collaboration.
quote: others believed that the culture had been purposefully fostered by department leaders

finding: Social identity (personality, desire to provide good customer/patient service, motivation to contribute to the collective good) facilitated collaboration.
quote: an individual's personality or desire to provide good customer/patient service facilitated intraorganizational collaboration

finding: Raised expectations: interviewees saw communication increasing but true, deeper collaboration happening less than they wished; unsure how to move collaboration past the clouds.
quote: pushing past surface-level interactions to be truly collaborative with others was happening less frequently than they would like

finding: Lack of slack resources (time, human capital), lack of colocation and not having the right people at meetings impeded collaboration; collaboration had to be weighed against other deliverables.
quote: a lack of time or sufficient human capital to devote to the creation and maintenance of intraorganizational collaborations

finding: Member's self-interest: individually focused services prioritized patients' needs and their own grants; direct patient care and physical separation from the main building ('4041') were a challenge to collaboration.
quote: interviewees expressed that being a provider of direct patient care could be a challenge to collaboration

finding: Lack of trust in collaboration driven by force impeded collaboration.
quote: collaboration efforts that were driven by force could lack the levels of familiarity and trust that can accompany organically driven collaboration

finding: 'Cloud' meetings were the most frequently mentioned facilitator, in 16 of 17 interviews.
quote: 'cloud' meetings were the most frequently mentioned facilitator of collaboration, mentioned in 16 of the 17 interviews.

finding: Number of interviewees (of 17) mentioning other facilitator themes: organizational structure 7, organizational culture 12, social identity 7.
quote: Organizational structure [...] 7 [...] Organizational culture [...] 12 [...] Social identity [...] 7

finding: Number of interviewees (of 17) mentioning barrier themes: raised expectations 12, slack resources 12, member's self-interest 7, trust 5.
quote: Raised expectations [...] 12 [...] Slack resources [...] 12 [...] Member's self-interest [...] 7 [...] Trust [...] 5

finding: Barrier themes differed by relational coordination score: higher-scoring services more often reported raised expectations, lower-scoring services slack-resource barriers; direct patient care was reported by both.
quote: Higher scoring services frequently reported raised expectations as a barrier to collaboration, whereas lower scoring services, such as those providing individual-focused services, more commonly reported barriers related to slack resources

finding: Facilitator themes did not differ by relational coordination score: clouds and structure were mentioned by services with both high and low scores; services mentioning culture or social identity did not have substantially different scores.
quote: Services mentioning this theme area did not have substantially different relational coordination scores than those not mentioning this area.
